workout_log.notes: One-off 3-sets-each scheme across 10 exercises. Leg Extensions 111kg×3×8 (below the 111kg×4×12 best, not a PR); Leg Curls 111kg×3×8 (same, not a PR); Inner Thigh 79kg×3×9 (ties best exactly); Outer Thigh 79kg×3×9 (below the 79kg×5×10 best, not a PR); Glute Extension 32kg×3×6 each (well below the 59kg×1×5 each best, not a PR — much lighter load this session); Leg Press 132kg×3×10 (ties best by weight/reps, fewer sets); Calf Raises Machine 83.5kg×3×6 (heavier than both prior figures but est. 1RM 100.2 vs 103.9 for the 76kg×4×11 best — not a PR); Angled Leg Press 152kg setup (45kg each side + 62kg frame)×3×8 (well below the 202kg×4×7 best, not a PR); Hip Thrust bodyweight×3×8 (unweighted variant, not compared to the 24kg barbell-loaded best — different loading scheme); Hack Squat bodyweight+42.6kg frame×3×6 (first time logged, no comparison). 0 new PRs — a deliberately lighter, higher-exercise-count session by design, not a max-effort day. 21:05.
